summary: The Latah County Library District emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for providing free and accessible internet access in their rural community. They highlight the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining fast and high-quality internet, which is essential for their mission of serving patrons.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would eliminate funding for broadband access in rural areas
claims.evidence_quote: Without the funding we receive, maintaining fast and high-quality internet for our communities would not be achievable without this funding.
